params.name: Input
params.description: The node whose closed surface is turned into a distance field and rebuilt as an offset surface or a shell.

params.name: Mode
params.description: Offset moves the whole surface out or in. Shell keeps only a wall between the offset surface and a copy moved inward by Thickness.

params.name: Voxel Size
params.description: Grid spacing of the distance field in world units. Smaller keeps finer detail but costs more; the grid is capped at 256 samples per axis.

params.name: Offset
params.description: How far, in world units, the surface is moved: positive grows it outward, negative shrinks it inward. 0 rebuilds it in place.

params.name: Thickness
params.description: Wall thickness of the shell in world units, measured inward from the offset surface.
